acoustic_rayleigh_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: High-velocity non-contact boundary extrusion of dense 95A TPU (Plate 1). Sliced with an automatic 10.5mm3/s volumetric flow speed cap to match TPU's high acoustic damping coefficient and prevent internal friction-heat build-up. Maintains a steady 2.0 Bar continuous compressed-air purge through the internal scrubber jacket to shield the ceramic crystals from thermal depolarization.

acoustic_rayleigh_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: High-velocity boundary extrusion of semi-crystalline Polypropylene (Plate 2). Enforces a hardcoded 14.2mm3/s maximum volumetric speed limit. This guarantees a minimum 0.06-second material residence time within the acoustic ring, allowing the Rayleigh surface waves to smoothly wrap the outer PP skin without creating micro-cavitation sputtering voids across the living hinges.
